reminders.arabic:
بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
reminders.translation: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful. Praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful, Master of the Day of Judgment. You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help. Guide us to the straight path, the path of those You have blessed, not of those who have earned anger, nor of those who have gone astray.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
reminders.translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. Be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
reminders.translation: You who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Allah is with those who are patient.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
reminders.translation: When My servants ask you about Me, I am near. I answer the call of the caller when they call Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me, that they may be guided.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
reminders.translation: Allah: there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the All-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and caring for them does not weary Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation. Kursi is left untranslated because published translations differ.

reminders.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
reminders.translation: Do not lose heart and do not grieve. You have the upper hand, if you are believers.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
reminders.translation: Those to whom people said, "The people have gathered against you, so fear them." It increased them in faith and they said, "Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs."
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
reminders.translation: Those who believe and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah. Surely in the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ
reminders.translation: And when your Lord proclaimed, "If you are grateful, I will surely give you more; but if you are ungrateful, My punishment is severe."
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic:
قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
reminders.translation: He said, "My Lord, expand my chest for me, make my task easy for me, and undo the knot from my tongue so they may understand my speech."
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
reminders.translation: Those who strive for Our sake, We will guide them to Our ways. Allah is with those who do good.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ۞ قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
reminders.translation: Say: My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Allah forgives sins entirely. He is the All-Forgiving, the Especially Merciful.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَـٰكُمْ شُعُوبًا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌ
reminders.translation: People, We created you from a male and a female and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may know one another. The most honored of you before Allah is the most mindful of Allah. Allah is Knowing and Aware.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic:
فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا۟ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ مِّنكُمْ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَـٰدَةَ لِلَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ يُوعَظُ بِهِۦ مَن كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مَخْرَجًا
وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَـٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
reminders.translation: When they have reached their term, either keep them honorably or part from them honorably, and call two just people from among you as witnesses, and give testimony for Allah. This is counsel for whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day. Whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them and will provide for them from where they do not expect. Whoever relies on Allah, He is enough for them. Allah carries out His affair. Allah has set a measure for everything.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation. These verses also contain rulings about divorce. The reminder is the whole passage, including the promise that follows mindfulness of Allah.

reminders.arabic:
أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
reminders.translation: Did We not expand your chest for you, lift your burden from you, the burden that weighed on your back, and raise your mention for you? For with hardship comes ease. With hardship comes ease. So when you are free, work on, and turn to your Lord with longing.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic:
وَٱلْعَصْرِ
إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
reminders.translation: By time, people are in loss, except those who believe, do good works, urge one another to truth, and urge one another to patience.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
reminders.translation: Say: He is Allah, One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْقِتَالُ وَهُوَ كُرْهٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تَكْرَهُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰٓ أَن تُحِبُّوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
reminders.translation: Fighting has been prescribed for you, though you dislike it. You may hate a thing and it is good for you, and you may love a thing and it is bad for you. Allah knows, and you do not know.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
reminders.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and give us mercy from Yourself. You are the Giver.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ ٱللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ وَإِذَا تُلِيَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُهُۥ زَادَتْهُمْ إِيمَـٰنًا وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
reminders.translation: The believers are those whose hearts tremble when Allah is mentioned, whose faith increases when His verses are recited to them, and who rely upon their Lord.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَىٰنَا ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
reminders.translation: Say: Nothing will befall us except what Allah has written for us. He is our Protector. So let the believers rely upon Allah.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: لَهُۥ مُعَقِّبَـٰتٌ مِّنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ يَحْفَظُونَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا۟ مَا بِأَنفُسِهِمْ ۗ وَإِذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ سُوٓءًا فَلَا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَالٍ
reminders.translation: He has successive angels before him and behind him, guarding him by the command of Allah. Allah does not change what is with a people until they change what is in themselves. When Allah wants harm for a people, none can turn it back, and they have no protector besides Him.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ وَإِيتَآئِ ذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَيَنْهَىٰ عَنِ ٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ وَٱلْبَغْىِ ۚ يَعِظُكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
reminders.translation: Allah commands justice, excellence, and giving to relatives, and forbids indecency, wrong, and transgression. He warns you, so that you may remember.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
reminders.translation: And the man of the fish, when he left in anger, thinking We would not have power over him. Then he called out in the darkness: There is no god but You. Glory be to You. I was of the wrongdoers.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: لَّقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِى رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا
reminders.translation: You have in the Messenger of Allah a good example, for whoever hopes in Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah often.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
reminders.translation: Has the time not come for those who believe that their hearts should humble to the remembrance of Allah and to what has come down of the truth, and not be like those given the Book before, so that time passed over them and their hearts hardened? Many of them are defiantly disobedient.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلْتَنظُرْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ لِغَدٍ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
reminders.translation: You who believe, be mindful of Allah, and let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow. And be mindful of Allah. Allah is aware of what you do.
reminders.note: English rendering prepared for this extension. It is a concise rendering of the meaning, not a published translation.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَلِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا، أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَلِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا، أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Actions are by intention, and each person has what they intended. Whoever emigrated for Allah and His Messenger, their emigration is for Allah and His Messenger. Whoever emigrated for some worldly gain, or to marry a woman, their emigration is for what they emigrated for.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 54, which is the whole report in that entry. Hadith 1 in the same dataset stops before the clause about emigration for Allah and His Messenger, so that shorter entry is not used. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ، وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالْحَجِّ، وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Islam is built on five: testifying that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing the prayer, paying zakat, Hajj, and the fast of Ramadan.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 8. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ عَنْ عَامِرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى عَنْ دَاوُدَ عَنْ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏
reminders.translation: The Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe, and the emigrant is the one who leaves what Allah has forbidden.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 10. The card shows the whole report. The edition adds other routes of transmission after it; those stay under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ وَعَنْ حُسَيْنٍ الْمُعَلِّمِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: None of you believes until they love for their brother what they love for themselves.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 13. Sahih Muslim records a wording that says "his brother, or his neighbor." The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ وَالِدِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: None of you believes until I am more beloved to them than their parent, their child, and all people.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 15. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give good news and do not drive people away.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 69. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: مَنْ يَقُلْ عَلَىَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مَكِّيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَقُلْ عَلَىَّ مَا لَمْ أَقُلْ فَلْيَتَبَوَّأْ مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Whoever attributes to me something I did not say, let them take their seat in the Fire.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 109. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، ثُمَّ سَأَلُوهُ فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، حَتَّى نَفِدَ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ مَا يَكُونُ عِنْدِي مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ أَدَّخِرَهُ عَنْكُمْ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْ يُعِفَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ اللَّيْثِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ نَاسًا مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ سَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، ثُمَّ سَأَلُوهُ فَأَعْطَاهُمْ، حَتَّى نَفِدَ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا يَكُونُ عِنْدِي مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَنْ أَدَّخِرَهُ عَنْكُمْ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَعْفِفْ يُعِفَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَسْتَغْنِ يُغْنِهِ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ يَتَصَبَّرْ يُصَبِّرْهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَا أُعْطِيَ أَحَدٌ عَطَاءً خَيْرًا وَأَوْسَعَ مِنَ الصَّبْرِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Some of the Ansar asked the Messenger of Allah, and he gave them. They asked again, and he gave them, until what he had was gone. He said: Whatever good I have, I will not hold it back from you. Whoever seeks to refrain, Allah grants them restraint. Whoever seeks to be without need, Allah enriches them. Whoever tries to be patient, Allah gives them patience. No one was given a gift better or wider than patience.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 1469. The card includes the occasion and the whole reply. The chain is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِذَا أَقْبَلَ اللَّيْلُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، وَأَدْبَرَ النَّهَارُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، وَغَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَقَدْ أَفْطَرَ الصَّائِمُ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَقُولُ، سَمِعْتُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَقْبَلَ اللَّيْلُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، وَأَدْبَرَ النَّهَارُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا، وَغَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ، فَقَدْ أَفْطَرَ الصَّائِمُ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: When night comes on from here, day turns away from here, and the sun has set, the fasting person has broken the fast.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 1954. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَمَنَعَ وَهَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ وَرَّادٍ، مَوْلَى الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ عُقُوقَ الأُمَّهَاتِ، وَوَأْدَ الْبَنَاتِ، وَمَنَعَ وَهَاتِ، وَكَرِهَ لَكُمْ قِيلَ وَقَالَ، وَكَثْرَةَ السُّؤَالِ، وَإِضَاعَةَ الْمَالِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Allah has forbidden you disobedience to mothers, burying daughters alive, and withholding and demanding. He dislikes for you idle talk, asking too much, and wasting wealth.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 2408. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ، فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا، وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَانًا ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: When you hear a rooster crow, ask Allah of His bounty, for it has seen an angel. When you hear a donkey bray, seek refuge in Allah from Satan, for it has seen a devil.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 3303. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الأَنْصَارُ لاَ يُحِبُّهُمْ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ، وَلاَ يُبْغِضُهُمْ إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ أَحَبَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ أَبْغَضَهُ اللَّهُ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَدِيُّ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الأَنْصَارُ لاَ يُحِبُّهُمْ إِلاَّ مُؤْمِنٌ، وَلاَ يُبْغِضُهُمْ إِلاَّ مُنَافِقٌ، فَمَنْ أَحَبَّهُمْ أَحَبَّهُ اللَّهُ، وَمَنْ أَبْغَضَهُمْ أَبْغَضَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Only a believer loves the Ansar, and only a hypocrite hates them. Whoever loves them, Allah loves them, and whoever hates them, Allah hates them.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 3783. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ، وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَكُونُوا إِخْوَانًا. وَلَا يَخْطُبُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَنْكِحَ أَوْ يَتْرُكَ
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يَأْثُرُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ، فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ، وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا، وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا، وَكُونُوا إِخْوَانًا ‏"‏‏.‏ وَلَا يَخْطُبُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَنْكِحَ أَوْ يَتْرُكَ
reminders.translation: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false kind of talk. Do not spy, do not probe, do not turn away from one another, and be brothers. A man does not propose over his brother's proposal until that brother marries or gives it up.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 5143. The same entry continues, after the quoted words, with the sentence about proposing over a brother's proposal. Both are shown. The chain is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm their neighbor. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should honor their guest. Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should say what is good or stay quiet.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6018. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ، أَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ، وَأَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ. ثُمَّ دَعَا بِعَسِيبٍ رَطْبٍ، فَشَقَّهُ بِاثْنَيْنِ، فَغَرَسَ عَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا وَعَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا ثُمَّ قَالَ لَعَلَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمَا، مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ مَرَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَبْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ، أَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ، وَأَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ ‏"‏‏.‏ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِعَسِيبٍ رَطْبٍ، فَشَقَّهُ بِاثْنَيْنِ، فَغَرَسَ عَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا وَعَلَى هَذَا وَاحِدًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّهُ يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمَا، مَا لَمْ يَيْبَسَا ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: The Messenger of Allah passed two graves and said: These two are being punished, and they are not being punished for something large. This one did not guard himself from his urine, and this one used to spread gossip. He then called for a fresh palm stalk, split it in two, and planted one piece on each grave. Then he said: Perhaps it will be lightened for them for as long as these have not dried.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6052. The card includes both statements and what he did between them. The chain is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: The strong person is not the one who throws people down. The strong person is the one who controls himself when angry.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6114. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. فَلْيَقُلْ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ‏.‏ وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ‏.‏ فَلْيَقُلْ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: When one of you sneezes, let them say "Praise belongs to Allah," and let their brother or companion say "May Allah have mercy on you." When that is said to them, let them say "May Allah guide you and set your affairs right."
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6224. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ. وَقَالَ اكْلَفُوا مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ الأَعْمَالِ أَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اكْلَفُوا مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ مَا تُطِيقُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: The Prophet, peace be upon him, was asked which deeds are most beloved to Allah. He said: The most consistent of them, even if few. And he said: Take on the deeds you can keep up.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6465. The card includes the question and both statements. The chain is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، سَمِعَ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَضْمَنْ لِي مَا بَيْنَ لَحْيَيْهِ وَمَا بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهِ أَضْمَنْ لَهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Whoever guarantees me what is between their jaws and what is between their legs, I guarantee them the Garden.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6474. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْصِنِي. قَالَ لاَ تَغْضَبْ. فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ لاَ تَغْضَبْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ ـ هُوَ ابْنُ عَيَّاشٍ ـ عَنْ أَبِي حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْصِنِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَغْضَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَرَدَّدَ مِرَارًا، قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَغْضَبْ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: A man said to the Prophet, peace be upon him, "Advise me." He said: Do not become angry. The man repeated that several times, and he said: Do not become angry.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6116. The card includes the request and that the same reply was repeated. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: اسْتَأْذَنَ رَهْطٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ. فَقُلْتُ بَلْ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّامُ وَاللَّعْنَةُ. فَقَالَ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ. قُلْتُ أَوَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالُوا قَالَ قُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكُمْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَ رَهْطٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا السَّامُ عَلَيْكَ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بَلْ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّامُ وَاللَّعْنَةُ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَوَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ مَا قَالُوا قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلْتُ وَعَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: A group of Jews asked permission to enter upon the Prophet, peace be upon him, and said "sam" (death) upon you. I said: Rather, "sam" upon you, and the curse. He said: Aisha, Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in every matter. I said: Did you not hear what they said? He said: I said, "And upon you."
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6927. The card shows that whole report, including the greeting that prompted the reply. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا. وَلَكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ وَإِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَىْءٌ فَلاَ تَقُلْ لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ كَانَ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ قُلْ قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and there is good in both. Strive for what benefits you, seek help from Allah, and do not give up. If something happens to you, do not say, "If only I had done such and such." Say: The decree of Allah, and what He willed He did. "If only" opens the work of Satan.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 2664. The card shows the whole prophetic wording in that entry, not a clipped first sentence. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، الأَصَمِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: Allah does not look at your forms or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 2564 (arabic number 2564.03 in that edition). The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: حُفَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ وَحُفَّتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ حُفَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ وَحُفَّتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: Paradise is surrounded by hardships, and Hellfire is surrounded by desires.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 2822 (hadith number 7130 in that edition). The card shows that whole report. Sahih al-Bukhari 6487 records the same meaning with the wording حُجِبَت. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الْحَلاَلُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشَبَّهَاتٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الْمُشَبَّهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِيِنِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ كَرَاعٍ يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى، يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُوَاقِعَهُ. أَلاَ وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَلِكٍ حِمًى، أَلاَ إِنَّ حِمَى اللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ مَحَارِمُهُ، أَلاَ وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ فَسَدَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ. أَلاَ وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْحَلاَلُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشَبَّهَاتٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الْمُشَبَّهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِيِنِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ، وَمَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ كَرَاعٍ يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى، يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُوَاقِعَهُ‏.‏ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَلِكٍ حِمًى، أَلاَ إِنَّ حِمَى اللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ مَحَارِمُهُ، أَلاَ وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ، وَإِذَا فَسَدَتْ فَسَدَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ‏.‏ أَلاَ وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: The lawful is clear and the unlawful is clear, and between them are doubtful matters many people do not know. Whoever stays away from the doubtful matters has protected his religion and his honour. Whoever falls into the doubtful matters is like a shepherd grazing around a reserve who is about to enter it. Every king has a reserve, and the reserve of Allah on His earth is what He has forbidden. In the body is a piece of flesh: if it is sound, the whole body is sound, and if it is corrupt, the whole body is corrupt. It is the heart.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 52. The card shows the whole prophetic wording in that entry. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ. قَالَ وَأَقْرَأَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي إِمْرَةِ عُثْمَانَ حَتَّى كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ، قَالَ وَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَقْعَدَنِي مَقْعَدِي هَذَا.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَلْقَمَةُ بْنُ مَرْثَدٍ، سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَقْرَأَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِي إِمْرَةِ عُثْمَانَ حَتَّى كَانَ الْحَجَّاجُ، قَالَ وَذَاكَ الَّذِي أَقْعَدَنِي مَقْعَدِي هَذَا‏.‏
reminders.translation: The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it. Abu Abd al-Rahman then said he taught recitation from the time of Uthman until al-Hajjaj, and that this is what seated him in that place.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 5027. The prophetic wording is the first sentence. The rest is Abu Abd al-Rahman's remark in the same Bukhari entry, not the Prophet's words. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوًا تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوًا تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: You see the believers in their mercy, love, and kindness like one body: when one limb suffers, the rest of the body stays awake with it in fever.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6011. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Two words are light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, and beloved to the Most Merciful: Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent, and Glory be to Allah and to Him belongs praise.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6406. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: مَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَلَغَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَوْضِعُ سَوْطٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا، وَلَغَدْوَةٌ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ أَوْ رَوْحَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: A space the size of a whip in Paradise is better than the world and all that is in it, and a morning or an evening in the path of Allah is better than the world and all that is in it.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6415. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ. وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الصَّبَاحَ، وَإِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الْمَسَاءَ، وَخُذْ مِنْ صِحَّتِكَ لِمَرَضِكَ، وَمِنْ حَيَاتِكَ لِمَوْتِكَ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبُو الْمُنْذِرِ الطُّفَاوِيُّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَعْمَشِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُجَاهِدٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنهما ـ قَالَ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَنْكِبِي فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ إِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الصَّبَاحَ، وَإِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الْمَسَاءَ، وَخُذْ مِنْ صِحَّتِكَ لِمَرَضِكَ، وَمِنْ حَيَاتِكَ لِمَوْتِكَ‏.‏
reminders.translation: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler. Ibn Umar used to say: If evening comes, do not wait for morning, and if morning comes, do not wait for evening. Take from your health for your sickness, and from your life for your death.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6416. The first sentence is the Prophet's wording. The rest is Ibn Umar's words in the same Bukhari entry. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih al-Bukhari. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَصِينٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ، وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ ‏"‏‏.‏
reminders.translation: Richness is not having many possessions. Richness is richness of the soul.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih al-Bukhari 6446. The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ. قُلْنَا لِمَنْ. قَالَ لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ.
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسُهَيْلٍ إِنَّ عَمْرًا حَدَّثَنَا عَنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِيكَ، قَالَ وَرَجَوْتُ أَنْ يُسْقِطَ، عَنِّي رَجُلاً قَالَ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ الَّذِي سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ أَبِي كَانَ صَدِيقًا لَهُ بِالشَّامِ ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ تَمِيمٍ الدَّارِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ ‏"‏ قُلْنَا لِمَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: The religion is sincerity. We said: To whom? He said: To Allah, to His Book, to His Messenger, and to the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 55 (arabic number 55.01 in that edition). The card shows that whole report. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
reminders.arabicFull: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلاَّ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ وَمَنْ بَطَّأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: Allah is in the aid of the servant as long as the servant is in the aid of his brother. Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes a path to Paradise easy for him by it.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 2699 (arabic number 2699.01 in that edition). The card shows this contiguous excerpt from a longer report that also speaks of relieving hardship, concealing a Muslim's faults, sitting with the Qur'an, and that lineage does not outrun one's deeds. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.authenticityBasis: Included in Sahih Muslim. That inclusion is the grading used here.
reminders.arabic: انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لاَ تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ.
reminders.arabicFull: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَلاَ تَنْظُرُوا إِلَى مَنْ هُوَ فَوْقَكُمْ فَهُوَ أَجْدَرُ أَنْ لاَ تَزْدَرُوا نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
reminders.translation: Look at those below you, and do not look at those above you. That is more likely to keep you from belittling the favour of Allah.
reminders.note: Arabic follows hadith-api, Sahih Muslim 2963 (arabic number 2963.03 in that edition). The card shows the prophetic wording in that entry. Abu Mu'awiya's extra word عليكم stays under Full entry. The chain of narrators is under Full entry.

reminders.arabic: القلب ملك وله جنود، فإذا صلح الملك صلحت جنوده، وإذا فسد الملك فسدت جنوده
reminders.translation: The heart is a king and it has soldiers. If the king is sound, his soldiers are sound, and if the king is corrupt, his soldiers are corrupt.
reminders.source: Musannaf Abd al-Razzaq, Kitab al-Jami', Bab al-Qalb, no. 20375
reminders.sourceArabic: مصنف عبد الرزاق، كتاب الجامع، باب القلب، رقم ٢٠٣٧٥
reminders.verificationNote: This is a statement of Abu Hurayrah, a Companion, recorded by Abd al-Razzaq. It is not a prophetic hadith. The wording follows the text on Islamweb's copy of the Musannaf and was not recollated against a critical print. The report continues by describing the limbs.

reminders.arabic: إِذا أردْت الِانْتِفَاع بِالْقُرْآنِ فاجمع قَلْبك عِنْد تِلَاوَته وسماعه وأَلْقِ سَمعك واحضر حُضُور من يخاطبه بِهِ من تكلّم بِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ مِنْهُ إِلَيْهِ
reminders.translation: If you want to benefit from the Qur'an, gather your heart when you recite it and when you hear it, give it your hearing, and be present as someone whom the One who spoke it, glory be to Him, is addressing through it.
reminders.source: al-Fawa'id, opening section. Edition listed by usul.ai: Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah, Beirut, second printing, 1393 AH
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic is the digital text as displayed on usul.ai, including its orthography. Check a printed copy of al-Fawa'id before treating the spelling as critical.

reminders.arabic: فَإِذا حصل الْمُؤثر وَهُوَ الْقُرْآن وَالْمحل الْقَابِل وَهُوَ الْقلب الْحَيّ وَوجد الشَّرْط وَهُوَ الإصغاء وانتفى الْمَانِع وَهُوَ اشْتِغَال الْقلب وذهوله عَن معنى الْخطاب وانصرافه عَنهُ إِلَى شَيْء آخر حصل الْأَثر وَهُوَ الِانْتِفَاع والتذكّر
reminders.translation: When the cause is present, and that is the Qur'an, and the receptive place is present, and that is the living heart, and the condition is present, and that is listening, and the obstacle is absent, and that is the heart being busy and absent from the meaning of the address, the effect follows: benefit and being reminded.
reminders.source: al-Fawa'id, same opening section as the previous passage. Edition listed by usul.ai: Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah, Beirut
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic is the digital text as displayed on usul.ai, including its orthography. It is Ibn al-Qayyim's explanation of Qur'an 50:37, not a separate prophetic report.

reminders.arabic: مَثَلُ عِلْمٍ لَا يُعْمَلُ بِهِ كَمَثَلِ كَنْزٍ لَا يُنْفَقُ مِنْهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ
reminders.translation: Knowledge that is not acted upon is like a treasure that is never spent in the way of Allah.
reminders.source: Ibn Abd al-Barr, Jami' Bayan al-Ilm wa Fadlih, report 1237
reminders.sourceArabic: ابن عبد البر، جامع بيان العلم وفضله، رقم ١٢٣٧
reminders.verificationNote: This is attributed to Abu Hurayrah through a chain recorded by Ibn Abd al-Barr. It is not a prophetic hadith. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: لَأَنْ أَجْلِسَ سَاعَةً فَأَفْقَهُ فِي دِينِي أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُحْيِيَ لَيْلَةً إِلَى الصَّبَاحِ
reminders.translation: To sit for an hour and gain understanding of my religion is more beloved to me than staying up in prayer until morning.
reminders.source: Ibn Abd al-Barr, Jami' Bayan al-Ilm wa Fadlih, Bab Tafdil al-Ilm ala al-Ibadah, report 109
reminders.sourceArabic: ابن عبد البر، جامع بيان العلم وفضله، باب تفضيل العلم على العبادة، رقم ١٠٩
reminders.verificationNote: This is a statement of Abu Hurayrah, a Companion, recorded as his own words, not a prophetic hadith. The Arabic follows Ibn Abd al-Barr. The chain includes Yazid ibn Iyad, whom hadith critics have criticised; the chain was not independently graded here. Circulating copies add other sentences, including that a faqih is harder on Shaytan than a thousand worshippers. Collections record those extra sentences as a separate marfu' report through the same narrator, so they are not on this card.

reminders.arabic: تَعَلَّمُوا، فَمَنْ عَلِمَ فَلْيَعْمَلْ
reminders.translation: Learn, and whoever gains knowledge should act upon it.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Reported from Ibn Mas'ud in the chapter on acting upon knowledge. Other transmissions of this wording exist.

reminders.arabic: هَتَفَ الْعِلْمُ بِالْعَمَلِ، فَإِنْ أَجَابَهُ وَإِلَّا ارْتَحَلَ
reminders.translation: Knowledge calls out for action. If action answers, it stays; otherwise it departs.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: A saying attributed to Ali in that book. It is not a prophetic hadith. The chain in this book should not be assumed authentic.

reminders.arabic: إِنَّ أَخْوَفَ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَى نَفْسِي أَنْ يُقَالَ لِي: يَا عُوَيْمِرُ، هَلْ عَلِمْتَ؟ فَأَقُولَ: نَعَمْ، فَيُقَالَ: فَمَاذَا عَمِلْتَ فِيمَا عَلِمْتَ؟
reminders.translation: What I fear most is being asked: 'O Uwaymir, did you know?' I will say yes, and then be asked: 'What did you do with what you knew?'
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: A report attributed to Abu al-Darda in that book. It is not a prophetic hadith.

reminders.arabic: مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْعِلْمَ لِلْعَمَلِ كَسَرَهُ عِلْمُهُ، وَمَنْ طَلَبَهُ لِغَيْرِ الْعَمَلِ زَادَهُ فَخْرًا
reminders.translation: Whoever seeks knowledge to act upon it will be humbled by it; whoever seeks it for anything else will only grow in pride.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Attributed to Malik ibn Dinar in the chapter on acting upon knowledge.

reminders.arabic: لَا يَزَالُ الْعَالِمُ جَاهِلًا بِمَا عَلِمَ حَتَّى يَعْمَلَ بِهِ
reminders.translation: A person remains ignorant of the knowledge he possesses until he puts it into practice.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Attributed to al-Fudayl ibn Iyad in the cited collection.

reminders.arabic: الْعِلْمُ إِنْ لَمْ يَنْفَعْكَ ضَرَّكَ
reminders.translation: If knowledge does not benefit you, it will harm you.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Recorded as a saying of Sufyan ibn Uyaynah in the cited collection.

reminders.arabic: حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ طَلَبَ الْعِلْمَ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ وَقَارٌ وَسَكِينَةٌ وَخَشْيَةٌ
reminders.translation: It is fitting for the seeker of knowledge to have dignity, calm, and reverent fear of Allah.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Malik ibn Anas, vol. 6
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة مالك بن أنس، ج٦
reminders.verificationNote: Recorded as a statement of Imam Malik in Hilyat al-Awliya.

reminders.arabic: مَا كُنْتَ لَاعِبًا فَلَا تَلْعَبَنَّ بِدِينِكَ
reminders.translation: Whatever you may play around with, never play around with your religion.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Malik ibn Anas, vol. 6
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة مالك بن أنس، ج٦
reminders.verificationNote: Recorded in Hilyat al-Awliya with an attribution to Imam Malik.

reminders.arabic: مَا ضُرِبَ عَبْدٌ بِعُقُوبَةٍ أَعْظَمَ مِنْ قَسْوَةِ الْقَلْبِ وَالْبُعْدِ عَنِ اللَّهِ
reminders.translation: A person is never struck with a punishment greater than a hardened heart and distance from Allah.
reminders.source: al-Fawa'id. Wording as cited on Islamweb.
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows the wording displayed on Islamweb as from al-Fawa'id. Check a printed copy before treating the page number or spelling as critical.

reminders.arabic: فِي الْقَلْبِ قَسْوَةٌ لَا يُذِيبُهَا إِلَّا ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
reminders.translation: There is a hardness in the heart that nothing can melt except the remembrance of Allah.
reminders.source: Attributed to Ibn al-Qayyim in Islamweb's discussion of hardness of the heart
reminders.verificationNote: The wording was not recollated against a printed edition of al-Fawa'id. Compare a printed copy before treating the spelling as critical.

reminders.arabic: إِنِّي لَأَحْسَبُ الْعَبْدَ يَنْسَى الْعِلْمَ كَانَ يَعْلَمُهُ بِالْخَطِيئَةِ يَعْمَلُهَا
reminders.translation: I believe a person may forget knowledge he once possessed because of a sin he commits.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Attributed to Ibn Mas'ud in the cited collection. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: يَا حَمَلَةَ الْعِلْمِ، اعْمَلُوا بِهِ
reminders.translation: O bearers of knowledge, act upon what you know.
reminders.source: Ibn Abd al-Barr, Jami' Bayan al-Ilm wa Fadlih, report 1237
reminders.sourceArabic: ابن عبد البر، جامع بيان العلم وفضله، رقم ١٢٣٧
reminders.verificationNote: The beginning of a longer report attributed to Ali. It is not a prophetic hadith. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: إِنَّمَا يُرَادُ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ الْعَمَلُ
reminders.translation: The purpose of knowledge is to put it into practice.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: Recorded among the statements attributed to al-Fudayl ibn Iyad.

reminders.arabic: الدُّنْيَا جَهْلٌ وَمَوَاتٌ إِلَّا الْعِلْمَ، وَالْعِلْمُ كُلُّهُ حُجَّةٌ إِلَّا الْعَمَلَ بِهِ
reminders.translation: The world is ignorance and lifelessness except for knowledge, and knowledge is a proof against you unless you act upon it.
reminders.source: Al-Khatib al-Baghdadi, Iqtida' al-Ilm al-Amal
reminders.verificationNote: A saying attributed to Sahl al-Tustari. This is an excerpt from a longer statement in that collection.

reminders.arabic: ابْنَ آدَمَ إِنَّمَا أَنْتَ أَيَّامٌ، كُلَّمَا ذَهَبَ يَوْمٌ ذَهَبَ بَعْضُكَ
reminders.translation: Son of Adam, you are only days. Whenever a day goes, part of you has gone.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of al-Hasan al-Basri, vol. 2, p. 148
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة الحسن البصري، ج٢، ص١٤٨
reminders.verificationNote: Recorded from al-Hasan in Islamweb's copy of Hilyat al-Awliya. The chain in that book includes Salih al-Murri, whom hadith critics have criticised. The chain was not independently graded here. It is not a prophetic hadith.

reminders.arabic: خَرَجَ أَهْلُ الدُّنْيَا مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ يَذُوقُوا أَطْيَبَ شَيْءٍ فِيهَا، قَالُوا: وَمَا هُوَ يَا أَبَا يَحْيَى؟ قَالَ: مَعْرِفَةُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى
reminders.translation: The people of this world left it without tasting the sweetest thing in it. They said: What is it, Abu Yahya? He said: Knowing Allah.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Malik ibn Dinar, vol. 2, p. 358
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة مالك بن دينار، ج٢، ص٣٥٨
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows Islamweb's copy of Hilyat al-Awliya. It is a statement of Malik ibn Dinar, not a prophetic hadith. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: عَلَى الْقَلْبِ ثَلَاثَةُ أَغْطِيَةٍ: الْفَرَحُ وَالْحَزَنُ وَالسُّرُورُ، فَإِذَا فَرِحْتَ بِالْمَوْجُودِ فَأَنْتَ حَرِيصٌ وَالْحَرِيصُ مَحْرُومٌ، وَإِذَا حَزِنْتَ عَلَى الْمَفْقُودِ فَأَنْتَ سَاخِطٌ وَالسَّاخِطُ مُعَذَّبٌ، وَإِذَا سُرِرْتَ بِالْمَدْحِ فَأَنْتَ مُعْجَبٌ وَالْعُجْبُ يُحْبِطُ الْعَمَلَ
reminders.translation: The heart has three covers: joy, grief, and being pleased. If you rejoice in what you have, you are greedy, and the greedy are deprived. If you grieve what you lost, you are angry, and the angry are punished. If you are pleased by praise, you are self-amazed, and self-amazement nullifies the deed.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Ibrahim ibn Adham, vol. 8, p. 34
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة إبراهيم بن أدهم، ج٨، ص٣٤
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows the wording in the printed Hilyat al-Awliya, vol. 8, p. 34, as displayed in digital copies of that edition. The report continues by citing Qur'an 57:23 as its evidence. It is not a prophetic hadith. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا لَيْسَتْ بِدَارِ قَرَارِكُمْ، دَارٌ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهَا الْفَنَاءَ، وَكَتَبَ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا مِنْهَا الظَّعْنَ. إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا لَا تَسُرُّ بِقَدْرِ مَا تَضُرُّ، إِنَّهَا تَسُرُّ قَلِيلًا، وَتَجُرُّ حُزْنًا طَوِيلًا
reminders.translation: This world is not your home. It is a house Allah has written to perish, and He has written departure upon its people. This world does not please as much as it harms. It pleases a little and brings a long grief.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, a khutba of Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, vol. 5
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، خطبة لعمر بن عبد العزيز، ج٥
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows Islamweb's copy of Hilyat al-Awliya. The card shows the opening and the close of this khutba. The middle of the sermon is omitted. It is not a prophetic hadith.

reminders.arabic: الزُّهْدُ فِي الدُّنْيَا قَصْرُ الْأَمَلِ، لَيْسَ بِأَكْلِ الْغَلِيظِ، وَلَا لُبْسِ الْعَبَاءِ
reminders.translation: Zuhd in this world is short hope. It is not coarse food and a wool cloak.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Sufyan al-Thawri, vol. 6, p. 387
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة سفيان الثوري، ج٦، ص٣٨٧
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows Islamweb's copy of Hilyat al-Awliya, from Waki' from Sufyan. Other transmissions in the same section word it as: zuhd is not coarse food and rough clothing; zuhd is short hope. It is not a prophetic hadith.

reminders.arabic: يَعْرِضُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى ابْنِ آدَمَ عُمُرَهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِهِ إِلَى آخِرِهِ سَاعَةً سَاعَةً يَقُولُ: ابْنَ آدَمَ أَتَتْ عَلَيْكَ سَاعَةٌ كُنْتَ تُطِيعُنِي، وَسَاعَةٌ كُنْتَ تَذْكُرُنِي، وَسَاعَةٌ كُنْتَ غَافِلًا
reminders.translation: On the Day of Resurrection Allah will present to the son of Adam his life from its beginning to its end, hour by hour, and say: Son of Adam, an hour came upon you in which you obeyed Me, an hour in which you remembered Me, and an hour in which you were heedless.
reminders.source: Abu Nu'aym, Hilyat al-Awliya, biography of Abu Sulayman al-Darani, vol. 9, p. 270
reminders.sourceArabic: أبو نعيم، حلية الأولياء، ترجمة أبي سليمان الداراني، ج٩، ص٢٧٠
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows Islamweb's copy of Hilyat al-Awliya, from Ahmad ibn Abi al-Hawari from Abu Sulayman. It is not a prophetic hadith. The chain was not independently graded here.

reminders.arabic: الْعجب مِمَّن تعرض لَهُ حَاجَة فَيصْرف رغبته وهمته فِيهَا إِلَى الله ليقضيها لَهُ وَلَا يتَصَدَّى للسؤال لحياة قلبه من موت الْجَهْل والإعراض وشفائه من دَاء الشَّهَوَات والشبهات وَلَكِن إِذا مَاتَ الْقلب لم يشْعر بمعصيته
reminders.translation: The wonder is of someone who, when a need comes to him, turns his desire and his concern to Allah so that He may fulfill it, yet does not ask for the life of his heart from the death of ignorance and turning away, and its healing from the disease of desires and doubts. But when the heart dies, it does not feel its sin.
reminders.source: al-Fawa'id, same chapter on wasted things. Digital text as on Shamela, Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah edition
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows the digital text of al-Fawa'id on Shamela (Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah), immediately after the sentence on wasting the heart and wasting time. The short circulating sentence that the heart is ruined by turning away from Allah and set right by turning to Him was not found in that wording in this edition, so the card uses this print passage on the death of the heart through ignorance and turning away. Check a printed copy before treating the spelling as critical.

reminders.arabic: أعظم هَذِه الإضاعات إضاعتان هما أصل كل إِضَاعَة إِضَاعَة الْقلب وإضاعة الْوَقْت فإضاعة الْقلب من إِيثَار الدُّنْيَا على الْآخِرَة وإضاعة الْوَقْت من طول الأمل
reminders.translation: The greatest of these wastes are two, and they are the root of every waste: wasting the heart and wasting time. Wasting the heart comes from preferring this world to the hereafter, and wasting time comes from long hope.
reminders.source: al-Fawa'id, chapter on wasted things. Digital text as on Shamela, Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah edition
reminders.verificationNote: The Arabic follows the digital text of al-Fawa'id on Shamela (Dar al-Kutub al-Ilmiyyah). The chapter first lists ten wasted things, then this sentence. The initial connecting و in the print was dropped so the card can stand alone. Check a printed copy before treating the spelling as critical.
